subject: Coord: tri-region technical deep dive (SE + architects) — twilight overlap options
body_preview: Alex asking for a short cross-region deep dive; Aditya proposes concise 'twilight overlap' slots (UTC + local times) and flags DST pitfalls; Monica prefers 60m and asks for an architect deck; final confirms 30-min slot and requests calendar invite.
messages:
From: Alex Li <alex.li@acmecloud.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@infraworks.io>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quick request: technical deep dive with our architects (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Aditya & Monica,

Thanks for agreeing to scope a technical deep dive. Our infra and platform architects (myself + Priya) want a focused session with your Solutions Engineer to validate latency/throughput expectations and integration points.

We have teams in:
- US (PST) — West Coast engineers
- EU (CET) — architects in Amsterdam
- APAC (SGT) — Canberra/Singapore engineers

Can we aim for a 45–60 minute session next week? We know tri-region meetings are painful with DST differences — a short overlap window would be ideal. If you can propose 2–3 concrete UTC slots that also show local times for each region we can pick quickly.

Context: planned focus on model routing, KV cache behavior under concurrent sessions, and fallback policies.

Attachments: none from our side now.

Best,
Alex Li
Senior Platform Architect | Acme Cloud
alex.li@acmecloud.com
+1 (425) 555-0198

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick request: technical deep dive with our architects (US/EU/APAC)

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can definitely run this; appreciate the focus.

Short note up front: Feb is DST-stable for EU/US (US DST starts in March), but APAC is steady — still, when we plan repeatedly it's worth anchoring to UTC to avoid mid-quarter confusion.

To keep the session sharp for architects, I recommend 30 minutes for the initial sync + optional follow-up 30 if we need a walk-through of traces/logs. Below are three concrete UTC slots and local conversions. I call the middle option the "twilight overlap" because it sits between US afternoon and APAC morning while being late-evening EU.

Option A — 2027-02-16T22:00Z (45 min
- US (PST): 14:00
- EU (CET): 23:00
- APAC (SGT/AEDT): 07:00 (+1 day)

Option B — 2027-02-17T01:30Z (30 min) — "twilight overlap" (my strong preference)
- US (PST): 17:30 (previous day)
- EU (CET): 02:30
- APAC (SGT/AEDT): 10:30

Option C — 2027-02-17T05:00Z (60 min)
- US (PST): 21:00 (previous day)
- EU (CET): 06:00
- APAC (SGT/AEDT): 14:00

Notes:
- Option B is shortest and creates minimal engineer disruption; Option C is larger daytime for APAC but late for EU.
- If you want a 60-minute block, we can do Option C or expand Option B by +30.

I've attached a short architect deck (acme-architect-pack.pdf) with our intended run-of-show and a one-click invite (twilight-invite.ics) for Option B; if that looks good we can circulate an official calendar invite and include the SE and your architect list.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Lead, Field Eng | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0102

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@acmecloud.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 18:04:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Quick request: technical deep dive with our architects (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks Aditya — useful framing and nice to see local conversions.

Two quick asks from our side before we lock:
1) Can we make this 60 minutes? Our architects prefer an extra 15–30 to walk a short integration diagram and follow a couple of example traces.
2) Please confirm attendee list from your side (SE + one engineer + product manager) so I can mirror it with our SRE/arch leads.

Tentatively leaning to Option C for 60 min, but we'll accept Option B (30 min) if your team can commit to a follow-up 30-minute teardown within 48 hours.

Attached: I added a lightly redacted architect checklist to the drive link (https://drive.redwood/example/acme/architect-pack).

On availability: I'm blocked afternoon PST on 2/16 but free in the evening for 2/17 UTC slots. Karthik, can you confirm SE coverage for Option B + short follow-up?

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Alex Li <alex.li@acmecloud.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@infraworks.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 01:15:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Quick request: technical deep dive with our architects (US/EU/APAC)

Monica / Aditya — thanks, that all sounds fine. We can do 60 minutes if Option C works for your SE team. Otherwise Option B + guaranteed follow-up works for us.

We're going to choose Option B (2027-02-17T01:30Z) for the narrow sync, then hold a 30-minute teardown the following business day (TBD) if needed. Please send the calendar invite with all attendees and the call link.
